'''Kayacun''' is a town in [[Saldaea]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kayacun}}

==Locations and Notable Residents==
Kayacun has an inn called [[The Queen's Lance]]. Residents include [[Weilin Aldragoran|Weilin]] and [[Alida Aldragoran]], a [[Malkieri]] and [[Saldaean]] couple, was well as [[Ruthan]], a clerk in the service of Weilin.{{ref/book|11|20}}

==Activities==
After [[Traveling]] to [[World's End]] and leaving [[Lan Mandragoran]] there, [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] Travels to Kayacun. There, she enlists the help of Weilin Aldragoran, as well as every Malkieri she can find in the [[Borderlands]], to ride to [[Fal Moran]] for Lan.{{ref/book|11|20}}
